content.text: how can i give you access to the skilss in the skills/ folder
I’ll check how this repo’s `skills/` folder is set up and the local Codex guidance. I’m using the openai-docs skill for the setup details.

I already have filesystem access—I found [skills/setup-env/SKILL.md](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/skills/setup-env/SKILL.md). You can simply say:

> Use the skill at `skills/setup-env/SKILL.md`.

For **automatic discovery**, Codex scans `.agents/skills/` and supports symlinks. You can keep your existing folder by running this from the repository root in your task worktree:

```sh
mkdir -p .agents
ln -s ../skills .agents/skills
```

That exposes every skill under `skills/`. Codex detects changes automatically; restart it if they don’t appear. See the [official skills documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills#where-codex-loads-local-skills).
